location_note: Eastern cardo in the Tyropoeon Valley and a stepped street in the Beit Shalom Garden on Mount Zion; no map reference. Placed by the title name Jerusalem (Z4).
notes: Study of three menorah graffiti on known street pavements. The Second Temple miqveh north of the stairs, the rock-cut reservoirs, miqva'ot and the Lower Aqueduct at Beit Shalom Garden are described from 1970s-1980s works and an unpublished report; cited, not coded. No feature rows.
